actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create a NEW complete two-weapon concept sheet for Bunny's contrasting twin fantasy daggers. White landscape sheet, Japanese anime hand-drawn linework with crisp broad cel planes. Show exactly two large complete front views, point to pommel, labeled DARK and IVORY. Keep all components easy to inspect; no repeated closeup or third weapon. These are related companions with DIFFERENT construction across blade, guard, grip and pommel, not one handle fitted with different blades. Both remain compact single-hand daggers around .22 of Bunny's full hair-crown-to-barefoot height, broadly comparable full length, not short swords.

CRITICAL REFERENCE ROLES: In reference1, preserve ONLY the IVORY BLADE'S existing elegant forward-swept outline, bone-white color, pale-gray facets and its small dark-red root inset. The old plain DARK blade and BOTH old identical wrapped hilts have been rejected by the user and MUST be redesigned. Reference1 also guides clean drawing quality, not obsolete geometry. Reference2 is single-gloved-hand scale context only. Do not draw hands or characters.

DARK, assigned to Bunny's anatomical RIGHT:
Design a striking broad compact BLACK FANG. The blade is noticeably shorter and broader in proportion than the ivory blade, with an unmistakable angular outline: one outward-expanded angular shoulder, a few decisive non-repeating corners, an offset point and a concave lower waist. A strong oblique front edge and a broad central charcoal plane make it readable as a single deliberate fang. It must not return to an ordinary straight narrow blade, symmetrical leaf, rectangular cleaver or a chipped greatsword miniature. No saw teeth, repeated notches or rows of spikes.
Make a short asymmetric dark guard with a low shield-like angled lip on one side. Give it a rigid polygonal HARD GRIP with three broad segmented surfaces and clean shallow seams, no diagonal cloth wrap. A small recessed oxblood red detail sits near the guard. Finish with a compact offset chisel-like DARK POMMEL with one tiny ORANGE slit inset. The whole hilt feels rugged, geometric and compact, clearly unlike IVORY. Components connect continuously, no hinge or broken axis.

IVORY, assigned to Bunny's anatomical LEFT:
Keep the reference's attractive bone-white forward-swept BLADE shape, shallow root waist, clean curved cutting contour and pale-gray facets. Redesign everything below it into a graceful flowing hilt: a small crescent-like curved guard with ivory upper face and charcoal underside, a slim oxblood ferrule, a longer-looking smooth tapered charcoal grip with a slender ivory spine inlay, and a small ivory teardrop-shaped POMMEL with a tiny ORANGE dot inset on its side. No cloth wrapping, no polygonal segmented grip, no copied dark dagger pommel. This is fluid and refined, still a comfortable-looking single-hand hilt, not a long two-handed shaft or ring handle.

The two belong to the same character through restrained charcoal/ivory material planes and sparse red/orange marks, not through identical hardware. Blade/hilt segment ratios may differ; total visual scale remains comparable. Guards stay small. Keep original silhouettes with no Sunraku-specific motifs, crescent blades, tail hooks, engraved patterns or glowing colored veins. No extra functional mechanisms, chains or ornaments dangling past the handle.

High clarity ink contours, hard cel shadows and controlled edge highlights; charcoal reads black, ivory reads bone-white. No mottled white patches, speckles, dirty gloss, cloudy patina, grain, painterly airbrush gradients or photoreal product material. Generous white margins, no measurements, hands, sheaths, combat pose or scene.

reference_inputs.role: Only ivory BLADE shape/color and clean linework remain authoritative. Dark blade and BOTH shared hilts explicitly rejected by latest user steering and must be replaced.
Current gloved one-hand proportion context only, no hand rendered.

reference_basis: Actual inputs: rejected V1 only for its accepted ivory blade and clean linework, plus current glove construction for scale context. V1 dark blade and both hilts were rejected; V2 redraws them. Official research was consulted earlier, not attached to this call.
method: built-in image_gen.imagegen complete-image generation; byte-exact PNG copy and lossless WebP only

nominal_design.H0_definition: Current body crown to barefoot floor, 1475 px on canonical front; physical centimeters not set

fixed_sides.anatomical_right: DARK broad angular fang with asymmetric guard, hard faceted grip, dark angular pommel with orange slit; matching broad dark sheath.
fixed_sides.anatomical_left: IVORY swept blade, curved ivory/charcoal guard, smooth charcoal grip with ivory inlay, ivory teardrop pommel with orange dot; matching slim curved light sheath.
fixed_sides.view_rule: Front reverses screen left/right; rear follows anatomical left/right.

limitations: Each nominal .22H0, H0 catalog1475px hair crown to barefoot, not centimeters or proven ergonomic dimensions.
No actual grasp, drawing motion, collision, load or manufacturing verification.
